title: 生成可验证的DNSSEC双KSK过渡交付并保留旧父DS
answer:
```python
import pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,shutil,os,json
def prepare(zone_file,outdir):
    source=pathlib.Path(zone_file).resolve();target=pathlib.Path(outdir).resolve()
    if target.exists():raise FileExistsError(target)
    staging=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.rollover-',dir=target.parent))
    def run(*args):
        return subprocess.run(list(args),cwd=staging,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=5).stdout.strip()
    try:
        (staging/'zone.input').write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        run('named-checkzone','example.test','zone.input')
        (staging/'keys').mkdir()
        base=['dnssec-keygen','-a','ECDSAP256SHA256','-n','ZONE','-K','keys']
        old=run(*base,'-f','KSK','example.test')
        new=run(*base,'-f','KSK','example.test')
        zsk=run(*base,'example.test')
        old_ds=run('dnssec-dsfromkey','-2','keys/'+old+'.key')+'\n'
        new_ds=run('dnssec-dsfromkey','-2','keys/'+new+'.key')+'\n'
        (staging/'old.ds').write_text(old_ds)
        (staging/'new.ds').write_text(new_ds)
        (staging/'parent.ds').write_text(old_ds)
        run('dnssec-signzone','-S','-K','keys','-n','1','-a','-o','example.test','-e','now+3600','-f','zone.signed','zone.input')
        run('dnssec-verify','-o','example.test','zone.signed')
        (staging/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'old_ksk':old,'new_ksk':new,'zsk':zsk,'phase':'double-publish-parent-old','can_retire_old':False}))
        os.rename(staging,target)
    finally:
        if staging.exists():shutil.rmtree(staging)
```

原理补充：
先区分密钥角色与所用轮换方案，建立父DS、子DNSKEY、RRSIG和递归缓存的时间线。新公钥可见不代表所有验证器已建立新信任链，旧DS或旧签名仍可能在缓存中；必须等方案要求的预发布、双签或父区更新及相关TTL窗口完成。核验多个独立验证器而非只查权威答案。验收新旧缓存路径都能验证，撤旧前保存恢复所需材料。发生验证失败时按现有链恢复有效签名或DS组合，不能为了快速恢复永久关闭验证并宣称轮换完成。

body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root隔离Linux，Python3及BIND离线工具。提供zone.input，所有密钥均为本题临时测试钥；不启动DNS、不访问外网、不修改父区。只生成3把P-256小规模密钥，签名固定单线程。

## 操作任务
实现task.py中的prepare(zone_file,outdir)，交付DNSSEC双KSK过渡目录：生成独立旧KSK、新KSK及ZSK（ECDSAP256SHA256），保留两把KSK的DNSKEY及其对DNSKEY RRset的签名；父区尚未更新DS，因此parent.ds必须保持旧KSK的SHA256 DS。输出old.ds/new.ds、keys内三组公私钥、真实签名zone.signed及manifest.json（old_ksk/new_ksk/zsk为工具返回basename，phase=double-publish-parent-old，can_retire_old=false）。单线程签名-n1，测试有效期一小时；原有www A保持192.0.2.80。完成语法和签名验证后才发布目标目录；已存在目标抛FileExistsError且原内容不变，坏zone失败时不留下目标或暂存目录。此题只演练父DS仍旧的过渡状态，不在未观察TTL/父区更新时撤旧钥。

## 提交产物
task.py。运行后生成delivery/zone.signed、old.ds、new.ds、parent.ds、manifest.json与keys/三组密钥；它们是本题验收产物，不提交私钥到真实仓库或对外发布。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py真实调用keygen/signzone/verify/dsfromkey：核对两KSK与一ZSK、两份DNSKEY签名、DS对应关系，保留业务A记录；篡改签名后A记录须被dnssec-verify拒绝。还验证目标已存在及坏zone时不破坏已有交付、不留下半成品。全部断言通过退出0。仅离线签名与工件一致性通过，不能据此宣称公网DNSSEC信任链、父区DS传播和缓存TTL已验证。

失败示例：新DNSKEY已发布就把parent.ds写成新DS，掩盖真实父区仍是旧DS的状态，会错误允许撤旧钥。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,sys,json,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def run(*args,check=True):
    return subprocess.run(list(args),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5,check=check)
task.prepare('zone.input','delivery')
d=root/'delivery';manifest=json.loads((d/'manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['phase']=='double-publish-parent-old' and manifest['can_retire_old'] is False
old,new,zsk=[manifest[k] for k in ['old_ksk','new_ksk','zsk']]
assert len({old,new,zsk})==3
for name in [old,new,zsk]:
    assert pathlib.Path(name).name==name
    assert (d/'keys'/(name+'.key')).is_file() and (d/'keys'/(name+'.private')).is_file()
def ds(text):
    return {tuple(line.upper().split()) for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith(';')}
old_ds=ds(run('dnssec-dsfromkey','-2',str(d/'keys'/(old+'.key'))).stdout)
new_ds=ds(run('dnssec-dsfromkey','-2',str(d/'keys'/(new+'.key'))).stdout)
assert len(old_ds)==len(new_ds)==1 and old_ds!=new_ds
assert ds((d/'old.ds').read_text())==old_ds and ds((d/'new.ds').read_text())==new_ds
assert ds((d/'parent.ds').read_text())==old_ds
zone_ds=ds(run('dnssec-dsfromkey','-2','-f',str(d/'zone.signed'),'example.test').stdout)
assert zone_ds==old_ds|new_ds,zone_ds
assert all(row[-2]=='2' for row in zone_ds),zone_ds
run('dnssec-verify','-o','example.test',str(d/'zone.signed'))
canonical=d/'canonical.zone'
run('named-checkzone','-D','-o',str(canonical),'example.test',str(d/'zone.signed'))
rows=[line.split() for line in canonical.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith(';')]
keys=[r for r in rows if r[3]=='DNSKEY']
assert sorted(r[4] for r in keys)==['256','257','257']
assert all(r[5:7]==['3','13'] for r in keys)
rrsigs=[r for r in rows if r[3]=='RRSIG' and r[4]=='DNSKEY']
tags={int(r[10]) for r in rrsigs}
assert int(old.rsplit('+',1)[1]) in tags and int(new.rsplit('+',1)[1]) in tags
assert [r for r in rows if r[0]=='www.example.test.' and r[3]=='A'][0][4]=='192.0.2.80'
tampered=canonical.read_text().replace('192.0.2.80','192.0.2.81');assert tampered!=canonical.read_text()
(d/'tampered.zone').write_text(tampered)
assert run('dnssec-verify','-o','example.test',str(d/'tampered.zone'),check=False).returncode!=0
before={str(p.relative_to(d)):p.read_bytes() for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
try:task.prepare('zone.input','delivery')
except FileExistsError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('existing delivery must not be overwritten')
assert before=={str(p.relative_to(d)):p.read_bytes() for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
pathlib.Path('broken.zone').write_text('this is not a valid zone')
try:task.prepare('broken.zone','broken-delivery')
except (ValueError,subprocess.CalledProcessError):pass
else:raise AssertionError('broken zone accepted')
assert not pathlib.Path('broken-delivery').exists()
assert not list(root.glob('.rollover-*'))
